claims.claim: ARRAY's orderbook reached a record $2.5B at June 30, up 37% year over year, with >$500M new quarterly orders, 1.5x TTM book-to-bill, 100+ GW delivered and continued tracker-product expansion.

risks.risk: A large orderbook can be delayed, repriced or cancelled and does not guarantee attractive realized margins.

unknowns.unknown: Orderbook conversion cadence and cancellation exposure by geography are not fully resolved from the release.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $342.1M with 29.1% gross margin and 30.8% adjusted gross margin; the orderbook increased from the prior quarter's $2.4B record to $2.5B while product launches continued.

risks.risk: Utility-scale solar execution remains sensitive to project timing, trade policy, financing costs and customer concentration.

unknowns.unknown: Full-year guidance performance versus realized H2 shipments requires subsequent-quarter confirmation.
